def code_challenge_method_s256(verifier, challenge):
    """
    If the "code_challenge_method" from `Section 4.3`_ was "S256", the
    server MUST compare the digest of the code_verifier to the code_challenge
    according to the following algorithm:

    1.  Compute the SHA-256 hash of the code_verifier.
    2.  Base64URL encode the hash.
    3.  Compare the result to the code_challenge.

    .. _`Section 4.3`: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7636#section-4.3
    """
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode()).digest()).decode() == challenge
